selected_step: Submit Quote for Approval to Regional Sales Manager

actions.details: Automatically submit the Quote to the 'Regional Sales Manager Discount Approval' approval process.

implementation.permissions_notes: Flow runs in system context but submission action requires user permission to 'Submit for Approval'. Ensure Regional Sales Manager has 'Approve Records' permission and Quote visibility.

governor_limits: Flow interview ≤1 MB heap; 1 DML operation for status update and 1 Action element; counts toward 2 000 executed-element cap; no SOQL/DML limits exceeded.
test_scenarios: Create a Quote with 18% discount → Flow fires, Quote is submitted to approval, approval request created for Regional Sales Manager.
Update an existing Quote with 12% discount to 20% → Flow fires, approval request created. Update Quote from 20% to 10% → no new approval submission.
